follow-up time: January 2013 to December 2018 (two phases: pre and post intervention)
exposure: Implementation of a clinical pathway tool for trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Women with one previous cesarean section and cephalic presentation at term pregnancy in a private hospital in India
finding: Implementation of a locally customized clinical care pathway tool was associated with improved VBAC outcomes in a private setting in India.
